main_text.head: BENEVOLO LECTORI.
main_text.p: IN primo statim Limine mihi conveni-endus es, quisquis es, amice Lector, orandúsque, ut partiare te paucis ante doceri, quàm in ipsas ædes intuleris pedem, quæ nos causa, ad isthæc quæ nunc damus evulganda, potissimùm impulerit. Equidem, si per alios licuisset, inedita malui. Cui rei vel hoc unum satis magno argumento esse pos-set; quod Prælectiones, aliquot ante annos mihi commentatæ, uno plus decennio ne plute-um quidem servaverint; sed sparsim in angulis inter rejectitias & nihili chartas neg-lectæ jacuerint: nisi mihi aliud suppeteret gravioris momenti argumentum, & quod suo indicio prodit, Operis ipsius imperfectio. Scriptorem enim oportet, qui sapit, dignitatique suæ & existimationi consultum cupit, inceptum opus ad umbilicum perducere; nec prius de emittendo cogitare, quàm fuerit (ut Cicerone loquar) aptum undique, perfectum, expletúmque omnibus suis partibus & numeris. Siquidem frùstra inde laudem speres, unde pulchrè tecum actum putes, si pro laude veniam mereare.

page.notes: The Greek motto's letters are too worn to read; marked illegible. Long s is normalised to s in the transcription as required. The left-margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. A faint, mirrored heading at the top is show-through and was left out. Italic/roman boundaries in the body are approximate where the scan is faint.
